On September 20, 2024, the Industrial Product Price Index basket was updated to reflect 2019 production values. The new basket was linked to the previous basket at the July 2024 reference period, so movements up to this period reflect previous baskets, while movements for August 2024 onwards reflect the new basket. The index was also updated to reflect the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) 2022 Version 1.0. For more information, please refer to our website (opens new window)."

On September 20, 2024, the Industrial Product Price Index was migrated from the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) 2017 Version 3.0 to the NAICS 2022 Version 1.0. The titles of the NAICS codes 315 and 3151 were updated (English text only).
